notes: Minimal IPyth interface — getPriceUnsafe (read-only, no fee) + getPriceNoOlderThan (built-in staleness gate). Pyth on Arbitrum One is a single contract; per-asset feeds are addressed by bytes32 priceId, NOT by separate contract addresses. Address verified live via eth_getCode on arb1.arbitrum.io 2026-05-02 (returned 1362 chars of bytecode). Same canonical IPyth ABI shape as the MegaETH deployment (PR #603) — Pyth uses CREATE2 to keep ABI parity, but the deployment address is chain-specific (NOT the same as MegaETH's 0x2880aB...). Reference: https://docs.pyth.network/price-feeds/contract-addresses/evm and https://github.com/pyth-network/pyth-sdk-solidity/blob/main/IPyth.sol
